nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What risks are associated with selecting high-performing individuals from coral populations?
nodes.answer: Selection can reduce diversity, which may counteract conservation efforts, especially in small effective population sizes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Coral reef protection|Threat assessment_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are some of the threats faced by tropical coral reefs mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Tropical coral reefs are threatened by global warming, nutrient pollution, and physical destruction due to anthropogenic stressors.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Coral reef protection|Threat assessment_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Why is assessing the risk of NIS proliferation in Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) complicated?
nodes.answer: It is complicated due to the need to understand multiple compounding factors involved in the risk assessment.
